description: Attach a skill to an agent so the agent can use it. Give skill as org:<name> or a bare name for a skill the organization published, adding @v<N> to pin a version; without a pin the agent follows the latest. An org skill must already exist (create_skill and publish_skill make one). Give catalog:<name> for a skill from Valet's curated catalog: it installs a copy into the organization, or reuses the copy installed before, and attaches it at its latest version. A catalog skill whose name the organization's own skill holds is refused. The agent is rebuilt so the change takes effect. A skill that is already attached answers that nothing changed, without a rebuild; one whose name another attached skill holds is refused with nothing changed. Skills attach to agents only. Requires connecting a Valet account.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the agent belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

skill.description: Required. org:<name> or a bare name for an organization skill, optionally followed by @v<N> to pin a version, or catalog:<name> to install and attach a catalog skill.

name: attach_skill
title: Attach a skill to an agent
